finalText:
**1082 hits in 94 files. About 1027 are safe. Four zones must not be renamed.**

| Zone | Files | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 1 | Public contract. Rename is a breaking change. |
| `lib/serialize.js` `WIRE` values | 1 | Right side is the wire name. Left side may change. |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 4 | Generated. `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites edits. |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 12 | Applied history. Editing breaks the down step. |

The safe 1027 sit in 75 service files plus [audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8). They split into three layers. Repo, service, http.

One catch. Repo SQL strings name the real column, as in [invoice.js:10](services/billing/src/repo/invoice.js:10). Those need a new `ALTER TABLE` migration, not an edit to an old one.

Sign off only if the plan keeps `serialize.js` mapping `owner_id` to `account_id`.
